name: IPCC 2006 Guidelines Vol. 4 Ch. 4 (Forest Land) — Tier 1 gain-loss
notes: National-inventory guidance; used here for default parameters, not for credit issuance.

name: Chave et al. 2014 pantropical allometric models
Verra VM0042 Improved Agricultural Land Management
notes: Covers emission reductions and soil organic carbon removals from ALM practices; not tree planting.

name: Verra VM0047 Afforestation, Reforestation and Revegetation
notes: Area-based and census-based approaches; requires baseline, additionality, leakage, permanence buffer, monitoring and verification.

name: Green Credit Programme — tree plantation methodology
notes: Green Credits are distinct from carbon credits under the CCTS (MoEFCC). Verify scope (identified degraded land parcels) before screening private farmland as applicable.

name: Carbon Credit Trading Scheme — offset mechanism methodologies
notes: BEE lists agriculture and forestry among sectors covered by accredited carbon verification agencies; project-level methodology approval required.

name: EU Carbon Removals and Carbon Farming Certification Framework
notes: Regulation (EU) 2024/3012. Certification methodologies adopted via delegated acts (2025–2026); certification is required — an estimate is never automatically certifiable.

name: USDA COMET-Farm
notes: Reference methodology for US farm/ranch GHG accounting; agroforestry biomass via growth equations based on Forest Inventory and Analysis data. Referenced, not copied.
